entry.title: New: Resolution 636 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AN AGREEMENT WITH THE STATE OF HAWAIʻI DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION, PURSUANT TO HAWAIʻI REVISED STATUTES SECTION 46-7, FOR A GRANT TO THE COUNTY OF HAWAIʻI MASS TRANSIT AGENCY

Allows for the receipt of $1,145,239 in federally-derived funds to purchase Americans with Disabilities Act vans to accommodate the increase in ridership within the Paratransit Program.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 636-24 & FC-204 - 10/16/2024
